[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"API Documentation and Specifications: OpenAPI 3.0 and AsyncAPI"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Clear, standardized API specifications are the cornerstone of modern software development. While REST APIs traditionally rely on OpenAPI 3.0 (formerly Swagger) for synchronous HTTP communication, event-driven architectures require AsyncAPI to document asynchronous, message-driven protocols like MQTT, WebSockets, and Kafka."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"1. Designing Synchronous REST APIs with OpenAPI 3.0"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"OpenAPI 3.0 provides a rich vocabulary to describe paths, HTTP methods, parameters, request bodies, and responses. Below is a foundational OpenAPI 3.0 YAML specification for a user resource."},{"order":5,"type":"code","text":"openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: User Management Service
  version: 1.0.0
  description: API for managing system users.
paths:
  /users:
    get:
      summary: Retrieve a list of users
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
components:
  schemas:
    User:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
          format: int64
        name:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
          format: email"},{"order":6,"type":"subheading","text":"2. Extending to Event-Driven APIs with AsyncAPI"},{"order":7,"type":"paragraph","text":"As REST architectures scale, synchronous request-response models are often augmented with event streams. AsyncAPI mirrors the DX of OpenAPI but focuses on channels, messages, publishers, and subscribers."},{"order":8,"type":"code","text":"asyncapi: 2.6.0
info:
  title: User Events API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Asynchronous events for user lifecycle changes.
channels:
  user/signed-up:
    publish:
      summary: Send when a new user registers.
      message:
        payload:
          type: object
          properties:
            userId:
              type: string
            timestamp:
              type: string
              format: date-time"},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"Best Practices for Implementation"},{"order":10,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Adopt a Design-First Approach: Write your OpenAPI or AsyncAPI specifications before implementing code to ensure stakeholder alignment."},{"order":11,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Automate Documentation Generation: Use tools like Swagger UI or Redoc to render interactive documentation directly from your source specs."},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Enforce Contract Testing: Validate your server implementations and client requests against your specifications during CI/CD pipelines to prevent breaking changes."}]
